snippet.description:
Original video credit: @misfit_barrel_racer

It might look crazy to repeatedly throw yourself into the dirt, but getting hung up in a stirrup and dragged is literally a rider’s worst nightmare! 

In this video, I’m working with Slick. He’s a super sensitive horse who takes things a bit personally, which makes this specific training even more crucial.
